div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://awatson1978.github.io/aerospace-medicine-ig/CodeSystem/isru-metrics-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Total mass of propellant (CH4 and/or O2) produced by the ISRU plant since start of operations
Operational status of the ISRU Sabatier/electrolysis reactor
Electrical power drawn by the ISRU plant

description.value: Measurement codes for in-situ resource utilization (ISRU) propellant production logs
